name: primitives-headless-checkbox

frames.best_why: Two boxes are checked and two empty, showing both states cleanly with no cursor over the card.

tagline: Checklist squares fill white and draw a tick when clicked.
summary: A launch checklist card with four task rows; clicking a square toggles it, filling the box and drawing the tick in with a short animation.
appearance: A dark rounded card with the heading Launch checklist, a grey subtitle and four rows. Each row has a small rounded square checkbox and a white task label; checked boxes are solid white with a dark tick.
behaviour: Clicking a square toggles it: the box fills white and the tick draws itself in over a fifth of a second, and unchecking reverses it. The whole label row is clickable, and the box grows slightly on hover.
demo_content: A Launch checklist with tasks about release notes, recording a demo, reviewing pull requests and shipping v2.4.
search_phrases: custom styled checkbox that draws a check
click a row to mark it done
light checkbox with self drawing tick
clean to do list in a card
unstyled checkbox you can theme yourself
use_when: A checklist or settings list needs custom square checkboxes with a drawn tick.
avoid_when: It ships unstyled on purpose, so you must supply the box borders, colours and focus ring.
customise: Wrap your own box and indicator as children, set defaultChecked or a controlled checked value, and style the square with classes; the tick path and timings are fixed.
weight_why: Four tiny buttons with SVG ticks; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.note: The tick is drawn with motion and no reduced-motion check is made; focus styling and the accessible name are left to you.

issues: Unchecked boxes are a dark outline on a dark card, so they are easy to miss.
Frame 4 catches the tick mid-draw and it looks like a stray slash.
polish_why: Crisp card and a satisfying drawn tick; unchecked boxes and focus states are faint.
title: Headless Checkbox
